summary: @qlik/eslint-config-vue preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then executes a bundled 727,680-byte single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js` under Bun via execFileSync. If Bun is already present on the host, it is used directly against the same file. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (rotating string-array `WV8StW`, mangled identifiers, large numeric constant table) and its behavior is not statically decipherable. The package is published as an ESLint configuration for Vue — a purpose that has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or execute a large opaque companion script. Running the payload under Bun also bypasses Node-based scanners. The package is published under the @qlik scope but the shape is inconsistent with a legitimate Qlik ESLint config, consistent with a namespace-hijack or compromised-maintainer publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
